measures.firing_all: share of all neurons firing per step
measures.firing_peak: peak share of neurons firing in one step
measures.sleep: fraction of steps the brain is quiet (sleep proxy)
measures.synchrony: fraction of steps with mass firing (over 15% at once)
measures.banana_dist: average distance to the nearest banana
measures.banana_near: share of time within reach of a banana
measures.firing.nose: firing in the banana-smell receptor neurons
measures.firing.legs: firing in the leg motor neurons
measures.firing.citrus ORNs: firing in the citrus receptor neurons (OR19a -> DC1)
